title: Prayer of St. Teresa of Avila (Govern Everything by Your Wisdom)
text:
Govern everything by your wisdom,O Lord,
so that my soul may always be serving you in the way you will and not as I choose.
Let me die to myself so that I may serve you;
let me live to you who are life itself.
Amen.
notes: Text as distributed in the 'Catholic Prayers' Android app (richarddean.angeles.catholicprayers).
